title: Regression: delegation sessions (review pairs) appear in the main Sessions list after the restart, including remote-host ones
outcome:
Reported by Greg after the 2026-11-23 restart onto fa953922 (Central host started 15:58Z), relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2601, 16:19Z), verbatim: „delegacje pojawily sie w liscie sesji” ("delegations appeared in the session list").
On his Sessions screen (All projects / All hosts) he sees delegation children such as "2B72-PAIR-1721C899: Claude /review-code" and "2B72-PAIR-792831BE: Codex /review-code", and many other pairs, shown with the remote-host icon.
The standing requirement is that delegations are available on demand only and do not fill the list of ordinary sessions.
Not yet established, no guessing:
- which hosts' delegations appear: Central's own, remote or federated, or both;
- whether this started with the fa953922 build or the restart. The previous running build was b35c79d1, from about 01:45Z; the change range since is b35c79d1..fa953922.
Constraint: diagnose and fix without deleting any session or delegation data.
acceptance: Exclude native local and mirrored remote delegation children from the main Sessions list for every project and host filter, retain ordinary roots, and keep child transcript/detail reachable through the owning host's existing parent or delegation view. Cover local and mirrored behavior through the actual summary/delta and detail paths.
No cleanup, deletion, or transcript/delegation rewrite; record the marker loss, its older introducing commits, and the inspected restart range.

completion.summary: Local and owner-classified mirrored delegation children are filtered from the main Sessions surfaces across project and host filters. Ordinary roots and owning-host detail access are retained. The fix retains transcripts, documents the earlier marker loss and introducing commits, and is merged and installed at fbc6fd0c.
